channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: U.S. holds on to defeat Mexico in the World Baseball Classic
item.description: Aaron Judge hits a two-run homer and Roman Anthony adds a three-run blast in a big third inning to lead the United States to a 5-3 win over Mexico.

item.title: Woman accused of attempted murder in shooting at Rihanna's mansion: What we know
item.description: Authorities allege a Florida woman inside a Tesla opened fire, hitting a front gate and a nearby RV at Rihanna's home. Suspect Ivanna Ortiz was arrested in Sherman Oaks.

item.title: New footage raises likelihood the U.S. struck an Iranian school where a blast killed at least 165
item.description: The investigative group Bellingcat says newly released video 'appears to contradict' President Trump’s claim that Iran was responsible for an explosion at an Iranian school that killed over 165 people.

item.title: What is Trump's true objective in the Iran war? U.S. targets provide a clue
item.description: The quieter side of the U.S. campaign suggests a political strategy that goes beyond simply containing the Iranian government, and may instead aim to lay the groundwork for its overthrow.

item.title: 'What is the mission?' With Iran, California military families fear another 'forever war'
item.description: The escalating Iran conflict has sent a chill through military communities across California, which is home to more than 157,000 active-duty military personnel.

item.title: Doorbell camera captures violent rollover crash that trapped 2 people on residential O.C. street
item.description: Two people were trapped after a car slammed into a pickup truck on a residential street in Fullerton.

item.title: Marco Rubio proves he really is Little Marco
item.description: Here's a reminder that no matter how high and mighty you get in Trump's White House, a Latino is still an exotic 'other.'

item.title: He was stabbed while charging his car. He died after his ambulance was stolen
item.description: The family of a stabbing victim is seeking $40 million from the city of Downey, saying a 'surveillance' sign led to a false sense of security, and an ambulance was missing a lock.

item.title: Choice of supreme leader reflects Iran's defiance, experts say, making regime change unlikely
item.description: The elevation of Mujtaba Khamenei to the post of supreme leader puts Iran on a relentlessly defiant path.

item.title: Hailing rides to and from LAX could get more expensive under new proposal
item.description: Los Angeles World Airports board is expected to vote Tuesday whether to hike the access fees for private transportation companies, including ride hailing, at LAX.
